title: Modernize the Contoso Orders platform
description: Move the legacy Orders service off Azure DevOps and onto GitHub + Azure Container Apps, with OIDC and no stored secrets.

title: Orders REST API (CRUD)
description: Expose create/read/update/delete for orders over HTTP with EF Core persistence.

title: As a client app, I can create an order
description: POST /orders accepts a customer and line items and returns the created order with a generated id.

title: As a client app, I can retrieve an order by id
description: GET /orders/{id} returns a single order or 404 when it does not exist.

title: As a client app, I can update and cancel an order
description: PUT /orders/{id} replaces customer details and line items; DELETE /orders/{id} cancels an order.

title: Order total ignores per-line discounts
description: The computed order total sums unit price * quantity but never subtracts the line discount.

title: Containerize and deploy to Azure Container Apps
description: Build a non-root container image and deploy it to Azure Container Apps using OIDC federation.

title: Expose a health endpoint for container probes
description: GET /health returns 200 with a small JSON payload so Container Apps liveness and readiness probes pass.

title: Add a Dockerfile for Container Apps
description: Multi-stage build on the .NET SDK image producing a chiseled, non-root runtime image listening on port 8080.

title: Negative line quantity is accepted
description: Posting an order line with a negative quantity should return 400 but currently persists the line.
